.CalendarMonthGrid {
  background: none;
}

.DateRangePickerInput {
  width: 360px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0px;
  outline: none;
  display: block;
}

.DateInput {
  width: 50%;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.DateInput_input {
  border-radius: 5px;
  color: #212330;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', helvetica, sans-serif;
  border: none;
  min-height: unset;
  padding: 11px 11px 9px !important;
}

.DateInput_input__focused {
  border-bottom: 2px solid #ff3636 !important;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.DateRangePickerInput_arrow {
  display: none;
}

.DayPicker__withBorder {
  box-shadow: none!important;
}

.DayPickerNavigation_button__horizontal {
  top: 12px;
  height: 40px;
  width: 47px;
  border: 1px solid #D9DAE1;
  border-radius: 3px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.DayPicker_weekHeader {
  color: #696B83;
  font-size: 11px;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.DayPicker input {
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
}

.DayPickerKeyboardShortcuts_buttonReset {
  display: none;
}

.CalendarDay {
  border: none!important;
  margin-top: 6px;
  border-radius: 0;
  position: relative;
}

.CalendarDay__selected_start {
  border-top-right-radius: 0!important;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0!important;
  z-index: 1;
}

.CalendarDay__selected_start:before {
  z-index: -1;
  content:'';
  display:block;
  position:absolute;
  top: 16px;
  right: 0;
  border: 4px solid transparent;
  border-left: 6px solid #F0F1F9;
}

.CalendarDay__selected_start:hover::after {
  content: 'Pick-up after 2pm';
  color: var(--slothPurple);
  background-color: #F0F1F9;
  width: 110px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0px 1px 1px #c9c9c9);
  font-size: 12px;
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: -30px;
}

.is-shipped .CalendarDay__selected_start:hover::after {
  content: 'Start Date';
}

.CalendarDay:nth-child(1):hover::after {
  left: 0 !important;
  right: unset !important;
}

.CalendarDay:nth-child(6):hover::after {
  right: -36px !important;
  left: unset !important;
}

.CalendarDay:nth-child(7):hover::after {
  right: 0 !important;
  left: unset !important;
}

.CalendarDay__selected_end {
  border-top-left-radius: 0!important;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0!important;
  z-index: 1;
}

.CalendarDay__selected_end:after {
  z-index: -1;
  content: '';
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: 0;
  border: 4px solid transparent;
  border-right: 6px solid #F0F1F9;
}

.CalendarMonth_caption {
  padding-top: 30px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

/* ------------- VERTICAL SETTINGS -------- */
.DayPickerNavigation__verticalDefault {
  max-height: 44px;
  width: 97% !important;
}

.DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault {
  box-shadow: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:first-child {
  border-bottom-left-radius: 3px;
}

.DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:last-child {
  border-bottom-right-radius: 3px;
}

.DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault svg {
  height: 21px;
  width: 21px;
}

.DayPicker_weekHeader__vertical {
  top: 62px;
}

/* ------------- CUSTOM CLASSES ----------- */

/* gives it full width of the container */
.DayPicker_FullWidth,
.DayPicker_FullWidth .DayPicker,
.DayPicker_FullWidth .CalendarMonthGrid,
.DayPicker_FullWidth .DayPicker_weekHeader,
.DayPicker_FullWidth .CalendarMonth_table
{
  width: 100%!important;
}

.DayPicker_transitionContainer__vertical {
  width: 97% !important;
  max-height: 50vh;
}

.DayPicker_FullWidth .DayPicker_weekHeader__vertical {
  left: 0!important;
  margin-left: 0!important;
  color: #fff;
}

.DayPicker_FullWidth .DayPicker_weekHeader_li {
  width: calc(100% / 7)!important;
}

.CalendarDay__selected, .CalendarDay__selected:hover {
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.CalendarDay__blocked_calendar {
  border-radius: 0!important;
}

/* LOADING STATE */
.loading-dates .CalendarDay {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ------------------------ THEMES -------------------------- */


/* CALENDAR CONTAINER */
.light .CalendarMonth {
  background: #fff;
}

.dark .CalendarMonth {
  background: #2F3144;
}

/* MONTH TITLE */
.light .CalendarMonth_caption {
  color: #212330;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #D9DAE1;
}

.dark .CalendarMonth_caption {
  color: #fff;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #181924;
}

/* MONTH SWITCH BUTTONS */
.light .DayPickerNavigation_button {
  background: #fff;
}

.light .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:hover {
  background: #f6f7fb!important;
}

.light .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault,
.light .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:hover {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid #D9DAE1;
}

.light .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:first-child,
.light .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:first-child:hover {
  border-right: 1px solid #D9DAE1;
}


.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button {
  background: #2F3144;
  border-color: #181924;
  outline: none;
}

.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault,
.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:hover {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid #181924;
}

.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:first-child,
.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button__verticalDefault:first-child:hover {
  border-right: 1px solid #181924;
}

/* MONTH SWITCH ICONS */
.light .DayPickerNavigation_button svg {
  fill: #696B83;
}

.dark .DayPickerNavigation_button svg {
  fill: #fff;
}

/* AVAILABLE DAY */
.light .CalendarDay__default {
  color: #212330;
  background: #fff;
}

.dark .CalendarDay__default {
  color: #fff;
  background: #2F3144;
}

/* HOVERED DAY */
.light .CalendarDay__hovered_span, .light .CalendarDay__hovered_span:hover {
  background: #F6F7FB;
  color: #212330;
}

.dark .CalendarDay__hovered_span, .dark .CalendarDay__hovered_span:hover {
  background: #F6F7FB;
}

/* BLOCKED DAY */
.light .CalendarDay__blocked_calendar {
  color: #D9DAE1 !important;
}

.dark .CalendarDay__blocked_calendar {
  color: #6A6C83!important;
}

/* WEEK HEADER */
.light .DayPicker_weekHeader {
  color: var(--eveningPurple);
}

/* SELECTED DAY */
.light .CalendarDay__selected, .light .CalendarDay__selected:hover {
  background: #383A53;
  color: #fff;
}

.dark .CalendarDay__selected, .dark .CalendarDay__selected:hover {
  background: #ff3636;
  color: #fff;
}

/* BETWEEN SELECTION DAY */
.light .CalendarDay__selected_span, .light .CalendarDay__selected_span:hover, .light .CalendarDay__hovered_span, .light .CalendarDay__hovered_span:hover {
  background: #F0F1FA;
}

.dark .CalendarDay__selected_span, .dark .CalendarDay__selected_span:hover, .dark .CalendarDay__hovered_span, .dark .CalendarDay__hovered_span:hover {
  background: #383a53;
}

 * react-circular-progressbar styles
 * All of the styles in this file are configurable!
 */

.CircularProgressbar {
  /*
   * This fixes an issue where the CircularProgressbar svg has
   * 0 width inside a "display: flex" container, and thus not visible.
   */
  width: 100%;
  /*
   * This fixes a centering issue with CircularProgressbarWithChildren:
   * https://github.com/kevinsqi/react-circular-progressbar/issues/94
   */
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.CircularProgressbar .CircularProgressbar-path {
  stroke: #3e98c7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  -webkit-transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.5s ease 0s;
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.5s ease 0s;
}

.CircularProgressbar .CircularProgressbar-trail {
  stroke: #d6d6d6;
  /* Used when trail is not full diameter, i.e. when props.circleRatio is set */
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.CircularProgressbar .CircularProgressbar-text {
  fill: #3e98c7;
  font-size: 20px;
  dominant-baseline: middle;
  text-anchor: middle;
}

.CircularProgressbar .CircularProgressbar-background {
  fill: #d6d6d6;
}

/*
 * Sample background styles. Use these with e.g.:
 *
 *   <CircularProgressbar
 *     className="CircularProgressbar-inverted"
 *     background
 *     percentage={50}
 *   />
 */
.CircularProgressbar.CircularProgressbar-inverted .CircularProgressbar-background {
  fill: #3e98c7;
}

.CircularProgressbar.CircularProgressbar-inverted .CircularProgressbar-text {
  fill: #fff;
}

.CircularProgressbar.CircularProgressbar-inverted .CircularProgressbar-path {
  stroke: #fff;
}

.CircularProgressbar.CircularProgressbar-inverted .CircularProgressbar-trail {
  stroke: transparent;
}
